name: Schweizerische Nationalbank
summary: Schweizerische Nationalbank, an independent central bank, provides banking services to the Swiss Confederation. Its services include account management, payment transactions, liquidity management, custody of securities, and the issuance of money market debt register claims and Confederation bonds on behalf of and for the account of the Confederation.
